entries.title: Tell HN: Archive.is inaccessible via Cloudflare DNS (1.1.1.1)
entries.author: ikeboy
entries.current_title: Tell HN: Archive.is inaccessible via Cloudflare DNS (1.1.1.1)
entries.excerpt: I noticed I couldn't connect to archive.is, eventually I figured out it was an issue with cloudflare DNS, 1.1.1.1. Checking nslookup confirms this: nslookup archive.is 1.1.1.1 Server: 1.1.1.1 Address: 1.1.1.1#53 Non-authoritative answer: Name: archive.is Address: 127.0.0.4 nslookup archive.is 8.8.8.8 Server: 8.8.8.8 Address: 8.8.8.8#53 Non-authoritative answer: Name: archive.is Address: 94.16.117.236 Cloudflare is returning a localhost address which prevents you from accessin
entries.guide_zh: 作者排查发现用 Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 解析时无法访问 Archive.is。
